why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the airdrop claim page Go to the Yield Basis Airdrop page , headed "Withdraw your vesting airdrop".
2 Step 2 : Connect your wallet Press the Connect Wallet button at the top of the app and connect your wallet, then look at the LP Season 1 figures.
3 Step 3 : Check your vesting figures Read the LP Season 1 section for your total airdrop, the share vested and the YB that is claimable.
4 Step 4 : Press Claim Press Claim and confirm the transaction in your wallet to withdraw the vested YB. You pay the network fee for that transaction.

5 Step 5 : Optionally stake to earn YB emissions On the Earn page , depositing liquidity earns YB emissions only if you stake the yb-LP shares in the gauge. Unstaked shares earn trading fees instead, and staked shares carry watermark risk. The docs on providing liquidity walk through a first deposit.
